product_metadata.title: Gourmet Basics by Mikasa Avilla Picnic Plate Napkin and Flatware Storage Caddy with Paper Towel Holder, Matte Gold
features: HANDCRAFTED: Made from heavy-gauge, carbon structured steel with a BPA-free, food-safe powder coating for long-lasting beauty, even under rigorous use; features a matte gold finish
MAXIMIZE TABLE SPACE: Display and neatly serve flatware, paper towels and plates with a built-in four compartment mesh caddy featuring a plate holder and towel spindle
SPACE SAVING DESIGN: Paper towel spindle folds into the caddy and the handle is removable for convenient, compact storage
CONVENIENT & EASY MOBILITY: Lightweight and portable with rustic-inspired handle for easy transport; no assembly required
INDOOR/OUTDOOR ENTERTAINING: Ideal for hosting indoor/outdoor dinner parties, events, and holiday gathering
description: From Gourmet Basics by Mikasa collection. This avilla matte Gold picnic caddy is a stylish way to bring flatware, plates and paper towels to the table. Handcrafted from wrought iron for long-lasting beauty even under rigorous use, this wire frame caddy features an attractive Gold finish, and a loop handle for carrying. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Measures 15 inches high.
